stages.note: Read this first — ten minutes here saves a second playthrough.
stages.title: Before you start — save discipline
stages.warning: No mission replay and no New Game Plus. The game gives 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave: keep one save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission. Never use cheats on a trophy save — they switch off trophies and saving. Expect about 200 hours for the Platinum; there are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies, so it is long, not hard.

stages.note: The opening hours. Short stage, one trap.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — Paradise
stages.warning: Do Lucia's balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends — it is the one true missable in the game (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a Chapter 1 save until that trophy pops.

stages.note: Partner play opens. Several systems unlock here.
stages.title: Chapter 2 — Two of Us
stages.warning: Daily Driver opens the garage properties and Moses opens the Scooter Bros app — buy garages early, because registering vehicles needs their free spaces. Partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) are available from here on.

stages.note: The city opens up; robbery routes unlock.
stages.title: Chapter 3 — Vice City
stages.warning: Run Race Against Yago the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive and counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens Sneakthief.

stages.note: The endgame of the story. Finish it cleanly.
stages.title: Chapter 4 & the Finale
stages.warning: Bank vaults unlock late in Chapter 4 through That's Where The Money Is. Keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission — there is no way back otherwise.

stages.note: Everything here stays open after the credits — no rush, no risk.
stages.title: Post-Story Cleanup
stages.warning: Strand finales, collectibles and money counters all stay available after the story. Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count toward Strangers & Freaks — check its counter after each strand.

stages.note: The long tail. Work the in-game checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
stages.title: The 100% Grind
stages.warning: The checklist bars run past the trophy targets: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations. Pace it — this stage is most of the 200 hours.

stages.note: Nothing left to plan. It pops on its own.
stages.title: Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
stages.warning: The Platinum lands automatically when the other 54 trophies are earned. If it has not popped, the checklist and the counters in this atlas will show you the one thing left.
